facts.fact: Inara 与 Felix 在龙穴盗宝后被龙火追赶逃亡，开场即奔命
facts.anchor: Inara screamed at the top of her lungs, a stream of blazing hot dragon fire right on her ass

facts.fact: Felix 的能力是唱睡歌，需约三十秒起效，追逃场面中派不上用场
facts.anchor: He had the ability to sing anyone and anything to sleep. The problem was that he needed about thirty seconds

facts.fact: 追他们的两条龙其实是幼龙（蓝鳞与林绿鳞），且停在洞口不肯进来
facts.anchor: They were baby dragons. Still the size of a double carriage

facts.fact: 现身的暗红巨龙颈长节节升高至五十英尺，体型比 Arelia 的宫殿还大
facts.anchor: Thirty feet. Forty feet. Fifty feet.

facts.fact: 巨龙喷火压盾、Inara 临近魔力阈值（流鼻血），她解锁了被明令禁用的 syphon 能力
facts.anchor: Inara unlocked the forbidden magic running deep in her blood

facts.fact: 暗黑之声诱惑她吸干巨龙，她只取火焰之力并靠母亲的告诫顶住诱惑
facts.anchor: You’re stronger than it is. It doesn’t control you. You control it.

facts.fact: 僵持评估后巨龙以一阵魔法冲击 Inara 的灵魂（红热火流），疼痛随即消失，她的灵魂开始搏动
facts.anchor: a torrent of red-hot fire exploded in her body. She screamed, her back bowing.

facts.fact: 章末巨龙弯下身，把背脊献给 Inara（收下她的伏笔）
facts.anchor: It bent down and offered her its back.
